snippet.title: One Dumb Wizard - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4603250/One_Dumb_Wizard/

One Dumb Wizard is an indie action roguelike where you play as a wizard hell-bent on getting their money back from the Bartender. Find charms to power up your wand, parts to craft new wands, and strategically sling spells in your singular mission to GET YOUR MONEY BACK.

#godot #roguelike  #indie #indiedev
